objectives.label: Watch the market of {settlement} at night and catch {name}

title: Thief-taker
The market thief
summary: Theft is rife in {settlement}. {giver} wants the market thief caught tonight — alive.
offer: There has been nothing but thieving here of late, and the folk blame the watch. Catch the one who robs the stalls at night, and bring back what they took. Alive.
complete: Caught at last. The stallholders will sleep tonight.
